summary: Iteration 35 — Event Dashboard + Attribution V1. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering GET /api/events (with lead_count/meeting_count/customer_count), GET /api/events/{id} (enriched leads with captured_by_name/new_returning/has_meeting), GET /api/events/{id}/dashboard (kpis, pipeline 7 stages, capture_methods, conversion, followups, leaderboard, daily_trend in event tz, cost with revenue/roi=null never fabricated), PATCH /api/events/{id} (event_cost + currency uppercased), POST /api/admin/leads/{id}/complete-follow-up, tenant isolation 403 for cross-tenant + empty events list, empty-event dashboard shows all zeros + null revenue/roi, and pipeline count == total leads invariant. Frontend UI (data-testid based): GITEX dashboard renders correct seed metrics (total=4, new=4/100%, returning=0, meetings=0, customers=1, conversion=25%, follow-ups-due=1 with 1 overdue, follow-ups-done=2), pipeline pipe-<stage> clickable and filters event-leads-list, capture-methods bar, daily-trend chart, cost card with 'Not available yet' for revenue/ROI, team leaderboard with 1 row and lb-sort dropdown, events list segment filters + 3 event cards. Tenant isolation on UI: work@gmail.com sees event-detail-error for GITEX and empty /events list (0 cards). Mobile 430px: no horizontal overflow. Arabic RTL: html dir=rtl, KPI labels translated (e.g. 'إجمالي العملاء'), no overflow.

minor.issue: Cannot unset event_cost back to null once set — Pydantic body 'if v is None: continue' skips null values in update_event(), so a user who typed a cost by mistake has no way to clear it via the API. Consider explicit sentinel or empty-string handling.

ui_bugs.issue: When event_cost is 0 (e.g. user cleared field), the card shows '<CURRENCY> 0' instead of 'Not set'. Condition uses `!= null` so 0 is treated as a real value. Recommend treating 0 and null the same for display, or hide currency when value is 0.

action_items: (Low) Allow clearing event_cost via PATCH (accept explicit null / empty). Currently the field is stuck once set.
(Low) In EventDetail.jsx line 190, treat event_cost === 0 the same as null (show 'Not set').
critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.py now 4237 lines — same maintenance risk flagged in iter34. Event routes (list/create/get/patch/dashboard + helpers) are ~270 lines and should live in backend/routes/events.py.
EventDetail.jsx (~282 lines) is dense but readable; consider extracting <Pipeline>, <Leaderboard>, <CostCard>, <LeadRow> sub-components for testability.

Follow-up bucketing logic in event_dashboard has an unreachable branch: `elif nf <= now.isoformat() or nfday == today: fu['due'] += 1 else: fu['due'] += 0` — the else adds nothing but implies future reminders are silently dropped from any bucket (they go into 'scheduled_future' via subtraction). Cleaner to add an explicit 'future' bucket.
Dashboard endpoint recomputes _lead_new_or_returning twice (once for nr counter, again inside leaderboard loop). Fine for current scale but O(2*N*T) — cache result per lead if lead volumes grow.
Tenant scoping: _event_or_403 correctly returns 403 for cross-tenant access; GET /api/events uses workspace_ids_for(user) which returns 'ALL' for SUPER_ADMIN — confirmed working.
